name: nyx
description: Self-contained script for cleaning forensic traces on Linux, macOS, and Windows.
readme_summary: Nyx is a self-contained shell script designed to clean forensic traces across Linux, macOS, and Windows operating systems. It systematically removes various artifacts left by user activity, applications, and system processes to help obscure digital footprints.
key_features: Cleans shell history, logs, temporary files, network configurations, user data, package caches, browser data, SSH traces, container data, systemd journals, print history, CI/CD traces, IDS/IPS logs, crypto wallets, privacy tool data, pentest tool data, OSINT tool data, IoT configurations, ML/AI frameworks, macOS specific artifacts (.DS_Store, trash, Spotlight indexes)
primary_use_case: Obscuring digital forensic traces on user systems.
cover_image_prompt: A shadowy, cloaked figure, representing 'Nyx', is meticulously erasing footprints from a digital landscape. The footprints are depicted as glowing lines of code and data streams. The figure uses a tool that looks like a digital eraser, dissolving these traces into faint wisps of smoke. In the background, subtle icons representing various operating systems (Linux penguin, macOS apple, Windows logo) are partially obscured by mist. Small, ethereal UI elements showing 'cleaning complete' notifications float around the figure. The overall mood is mysterious and clandestine, with a dark, cool color palette and dramatic lighting. The style should be a dark fantasy digital painting with a focus on atmosphere and clear visual metaphor.

name: Constrict
readme_summary: Constrict is a desktop application for Linux that allows users to compress video files to a target file size. It automatically calculates the necessary encoding parameters like bitrate, resolution, and framerate to achieve the desired output size while aiming to preserve audiovisual quality.
key_features: Compress videos to target file sizes
Automatic calculation of ABR, resolution, framerate, and audio quality
Choice of codecs (H.264, HEVC, AV1, VP9)
primary_use_case: Compressing video files to meet specific size limits for uploads or storage, without manual trial-and-error.
cover_image_prompt: A skilled tailor meticulously shrinking a large, vibrant bolt of fabric (representing a video file) down to a small, neat spool of thread. The tailor uses a magical measuring tape that displays target file sizes. Small digital particles representing data flow from the large fabric to the spool. In the background, a subtle UI element shows encoding parameters like 'bitrate' and 'resolution' adjusting. The scene is set in a clean, modern workshop with bright, focused lighting. The overall style is a 3D isometric illustration with clear, friendly iconography and a clean, uncluttered composition, emphasizing the transformation and precision of the compression process.

name: claude-code-karma
description: Dashboard for monitoring claude code sessions.
readme_summary: Claude Code Karma is a local-first, open-source dashboard designed to visualize and monitor Claude Code sessions. It transforms raw session data from `~/.claude/` into an interactive timeline, session browser, and detailed overviews of tasks, files, subagents, and skills invoked during a session.
key_features: Local-first dashboard for Claude Code sessions
Visualizes sessions, timelines, costs, and live activity
Session Browser with search and filtering
Real-time status badges for live sessions
Detailed session timelines and overviews (message count, duration, models, tools)
Tabs for Tasks, Files, Subagents, Skills, and Shells
Works with Claude Code CLI and Claude Desktop
primary_use_case: To provide users with a user-friendly, visual interface for monitoring and analyzing their Claude Code sessions locally, offering insights into session activity, tool usage, and agent interactions.
cover_image_prompt: A celestial cartographer meticulously charting a vast, intricate nebula composed of glowing code snippets and data streams. The cartographer uses a magical astrolabe to map out individual session timelines, represented as glowing constellations. Input data streams, like cosmic dust, flow into the astrolabe, and the output is a beautiful, organized star chart showing the 'Claude Code Karma' of each session. Subtle UI elements resembling a dashboard are integrated into the astrolabe's interface. The scene is set in a cosmic observatory with deep blues and purples, illuminated by the glow of data. Rendered in a 3D isometric illustration style with ethereal lighting and sharp details.

name: thedeck
description: The Deck: An Open-Source, Cross-Platform, Mobile, Turn by Turn Card Game Engine in Flutter
readme_summary: The Deck is an open-source, cross-platform mobile card game engine built with Flutter. It allows users to play classic card games digitally, with a unique feature where one device acts as a shared 'table' visible to all players, enhancing cooperative gameplay.
key_features: Unique 'table' device feature for shared gameplay
primary_use_case: To provide a digital, cooperative platform for playing classic card games on mobile devices, with a shared visual interface.
cover_image_prompt: A vibrant, cozy living room scene where a group of diverse friends are gathered around a coffee table. Instead of physical cards, a single tablet placed in the center of the table displays a dynamic, holographic representation of a card game in progress, with cards floating and interacting. Each friend holds a smartphone displaying their hand, with subtle glowing lines connecting their phones to the central tablet, symbolizing the shared digital table. The overall mood is one of fun and connection, with soft, warm lighting. The art style should be a clean, modern 3D isometric illustration with clear, friendly character designs and a focus on the glowing digital elements representing the game state.

name: dashy
description: 🚀 A self-hostable personal dashboard built for you. Includes status-checking, widgets, themes, icon packs, a UI editor and tons more!
readme_summary: Dashy is a highly customizable, self-hostable personal dashboard designed for managing and monitoring your homelab services. It offers features like real-time status checks, customizable widgets, theming, icon options, and optional authentication, making it an ideal startpage or homepage for tech enthusiasts.
key_features: Theming with UI color editor and custom CSS
Multiple icon options (Font-Awesome, Favicon, images, emojis)
Optional authentication with multi-user access and SSO
Optional encrypted cloud backup and restore
Customizable layout, sizes, text, and behavior
Options for background image, custom nav-bar, HTML footer
Easy setup with Docker, bare metal, or 1-Click cloud deployment
primary_use_case: To serve as a customizable, self-hosted homepage or dashboard for managing and monitoring personal homelab services and applications.
cover_image_prompt: A vibrant, organized control center for a futuristic homelab. In the center, a user is interacting with a sleek, holographic dashboard displaying live status indicators (glowing green for online, red for offline) for various services represented by distinct icons. Small, dynamic widgets show real-time data like server load and network traffic. The dashboard itself is a central hub, with clear visual pathways leading to different sections. Subtle digital particles flow around the interface, and the name 'Dashy' is elegantly integrated into the console's design. The overall mood is one of efficient control and accessibility. Rendered in a clean, 3D isometric illustration style with a bright, tech-focused color palette.

name: ailia-models
description: The collection of pre-trained, state-of-the-art AI models for ailia SDK
readme_summary: The ailia-models repository provides a comprehensive collection of over 400 pre-trained AI models for various tasks, including object detection, speech recognition, image generation, and LLMs. These models are designed to be easily runnable from a single command-line interface and are compatible with the ailia SDK across multiple platforms.
key_features: Supports diverse AI tasks (object detection, speech recognition, image generation, LLMs, etc.)
Single, simple CLI for all models
Cross-platform support (Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android, Jetson, Raspberry Pi)
primary_use_case: To provide developers with easy access to a wide range of pre-trained AI models that can be readily integrated into applications using the ailia SDK, simplifying the deployment of AI functionalities.
cover_image_prompt: A bustling, futuristic workshop where a central robotic arm, labeled 'ailia-models', is efficiently sorting and distributing a vast array of glowing, distinct AI 'tools' (e.g., a magnifying glass for detection, a microphone for speech, a paintbrush for generation) into different application blueprints. Each tool is clearly labeled with its function. Small, holographic screens around the workshop display simplified visual representations of the AI tasks being performed. The overall mood is one of organized efficiency and technological advancement, rendered in a clean, 3D isometric illustration style with a bright, optimistic color palette.
